lines.zh: 我横着走，沙粒在脚下响。
lines.en: I scuttle sideways, sand crunching under my legs.

lines.zh: 八条腿一起挖，沙坑越挖越深。
lines.en: Eight legs dig together and the pit goes deeper.

lines.zh: 我钻进沙里，只露出眼柄。
lines.en: I sink into the sand with only my stalks out.

lines.zh: 白天太阳太亮，我往沙下躲。
lines.en: The sun is too bright, so I burrow under the sand.

lines.zh: 我沿着潮线小跑，找湿沙。
lines.en: I trot along the tide line hunting damp sand.

lines.zh: 沙滩上留下我一串细脚印。
lines.en: My thin tracks trail behind me on the beach.

lines.zh: 我举着一只钳子，像举着灯。
lines.en: I hold one claw up like a little lantern.

lines.zh: 海龟一靠近，我就横过去拦。
lines.en: When a turtle comes near, I sidle over to block it.

lines.zh: 沙子滑，我走两步就陷一下。
lines.en: The sand slips and I sink a step every few.

lines.zh: 我壳很薄，走起来轻得像风。
lines.en: My shell is thin, so I walk light as wind.

lines.zh: 我绕开海浪，怕被冲走。
lines.en: I skirt the surf, afraid of being washed away.

lines.zh: 我在沙脊上停一下，看看四周。
lines.en: I pause on the sand ridge and look around.

lines.zh: 幽灵蟹钳就长在我这两只钳上。
lines.en: The ghost claw grows right here on my arms.

lines.zh: 我横着走，谁也猜不到我去哪。
lines.en: I walk sideways, so nobody guesses where I go.

lines.zh: 我停在沙坑边，听浪的节奏。
lines.en: I stop at the edge of my burrow and listen to the waves.

lines.zh: 潮水退下去，我跟着往下走。
lines.en: The tide pulls back, and I follow it down.

lines.zh: 我钳起一粒沙，又放下。
lines.en: I pick up a grain of sand and put it down.

lines.zh: 沙下有东西在动，我扒开看看。
lines.en: Something moves under the sand. I dig to look.

lines.zh: 我把眼柄伸得高高的，转来转去。
lines.en: I stretch my eye stalks high and swivel them.

lines.zh: 我在沙里吐泡泡，泡泡一碰就破。
lines.en: I blow bubbles in the sand and they pop.

lines.zh: 我磨着钳子，发出细细的声响。
lines.en: I rub my claws and make a thin scraping sound.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，装成一块白石头。
lines.en: I freeze and pretend to be a pale stone.

lines.zh: 潮水退了，我守着这片湿沙。
lines.en: The tide is out and I keep this wet sand.

lines.zh: 我听见海龟在远处划水。
lines.en: I hear a turtle paddling somewhere far off.

lines.zh: 我在沙里把自己埋到背甲。
lines.en: I bury myself up to the edge of my shell.

lines.zh: 风把沙子吹进我眼里，我抖抖。
lines.en: Wind blows sand in my eyes, so I shake.

lines.zh: 我在等一只不看路的螃蟹经过。
lines.en: I wait for a careless crab to wander past.

lines.zh: 钳子上还挂着昨天的小贝壳。
lines.en: A small shell still hangs from my claw.

lines.zh: 我晒太阳晒得壳都发暖。
lines.en: I bask until my shell feels warm.

lines.zh: 沙面下有什么在动，我听着。
lines.en: Something moves beneath the sand; I listen.

lines.zh: 我数着浪，一层一层退下去。
lines.en: I count the waves as they pull back.

lines.zh: 白天我多半躲着，别怪我冷淡。
lines.en: By day I mostly hide, so do not blame me.

lines.zh: 你把影子投在我沙坑上了。
lines.en: Your shadow has fallen across my pit.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的脚，那像两只大钳。
lines.en: I stare at your feet; they look like huge claws.

lines.zh: 你踩下去，我的洞就塌了。
lines.en: Step there and my burrow caves in.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看你，眼柄抖了抖。
lines.en: I look up at you and my stalks wobble.

lines.zh: 你也住在沙滩上吗。
lines.en: Do you live on the beach as well?

lines.zh: 你走轻点，沙下还有我同伴。
lines.en: Walk softly; my kin are under this sand.

lines.zh: 我认得你手里的网，别过来。
lines.en: I know that net in your hand; stay back.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来时，我往沙里缩了缩。
lines.en: When you crouch, I shrink deeper into sand.

lines.zh: 你的靴子挡住了我的潮线。
lines.en: Your boots are blocking my tide line.

lines.zh: 我看看你，又看看你身后的海。
lines.en: I glance at you, then at the sea behind.

lines.zh: 我壳裂了一道缝，疼得发抖。
lines.en: A crack runs through my shell and I shake.

lines.zh: 钳子掉了一只，我还能钻沙。
lines.en: Lost a claw; I can still dig.

lines.zh: 这一下把我从沙里打出来。
lines.en: That blow knocked me out of the sand.

lines.zh: 我钳子掉了，只剩一只。
lines.en: A claw is gone; I have only one left.

lines.zh: 我缩进壳里，可壳太薄。
lines.en: I pull into my shell, but it is too thin.

lines.zh: 血渗进沙，颜色变深了。
lines.en: Blood seeps into the sand and darkens it.

lines.zh: 我疼得横着乱跑。
lines.en: The pain makes me scurry sideways blindly.

lines.zh: 谁打我，我看清你了。
lines.en: Whoever struck me, I have seen you.

lines.zh: 我钳子举不起来了。
lines.en: I cannot lift my claw anymore.

lines.zh: 这点伤，我还死不了。
lines.en: This wound will not finish me yet.

lines.zh: 那条生鱼的味道我隔沙都闻到。
lines.en: I smell that raw fish even through the sand.

lines.zh: 你晃什么，我这小钳抢不过。
lines.en: Whatever you wave, these small claws cannot fight you.

lines.zh: 是贝壳肉吗，我经不住这个。
lines.en: Is that shell meat? I cannot resist it.

lines.zh: 沙里伸出两只小钳。
lines.en: Two small claws poke out of the sand.

lines.zh: 你放低点，我够不着你的手。
lines.en: Lower it; I cannot reach your hand.

lines.zh: 我闻到腥味，脚自己动了。
lines.en: I smell something fishy and my legs move on their own.

lines.zh: 别拿钳子逗我，我会当真。
lines.en: Do not tease me with a claw; I take it seriously.

lines.zh: 这块肉比海龟好对付多了。
lines.en: That meat is far easier than a turtle.

lines.zh: 我举钳子，是想要，不是要打。
lines.en: My claws are raised to ask, not to fight.

lines.zh: 你退后一步，我才敢叼走。
lines.en: Step back one pace and I will dare take it.

lines.zh: 你踢到我了，我壳差点裂。
lines.en: You kicked me and my shell nearly cracked.

lines.zh: 我横着撞上你的鞋，弹了一下。
lines.en: I hit your boot sideways and bounced off.

lines.zh: 别挤，沙坑就这么点大。
lines.en: Do not crowd me; this pit is all I have.

lines.zh: 我举钳子推你，推不动。
lines.en: I push with my claws and cannot move you.

lines.zh: 你踩塌了我的洞口。
lines.en: You have stepped my burrow shut.

lines.zh: 撞一下不要紧，我壳薄但硬。
lines.en: A bump is fine; my shell is thin but hard.

lines.zh: 我退到一边，让你先过。
lines.en: I back aside and let you pass first.

lines.zh: 沙被我们两个搅得满天飞。
lines.en: Between us we have flung sand everywhere.

lines.zh: 你再靠近，我就钻沙里了。
lines.en: Come closer and I will vanish into the sand.

lines.zh: 我这身板，撞谁都吃亏。
lines.en: Small as I am, I lose every collision.

lines.zh: 我用钳子敲沙，敲出节奏。
lines.en: I tap the sand with my claws in rhythm.

lines.zh: 远处有只蟹回了同样的响。
lines.en: Somewhere a crab answers with the same tapping.

lines.zh: 我把洞挖宽一点，等她来。
lines.en: I widen the burrow a little for her.

lines.zh: 我们并排横着走，谁都不快。
lines.en: We walk side by side, neither hurrying.

lines.zh: 她钳子比我大，我不敢争。
lines.en: Her claws are bigger, so I do not argue.

lines.zh: 沙下的洞够两只蟹住了。
lines.en: The burrow under the sand fits two of us.

lines.zh: 我抖抖眼柄，这是打招呼。
lines.en: I wiggle my stalks; that is how I greet.

lines.zh: 到了夜里，我们一起出来觅食。
lines.en: At night we come out to forage together.

lines.zh: 生下来的小蟹只有指甲盖大。
lines.en: Our young are no bigger than a fingernail.

lines.zh: 我们守着同一片沙，不分开。
lines.en: We guard the same patch of sand together.

lines.zh: 你把我拎起来，我腿还在划。
lines.en: You lift me up and my legs keep paddling.

lines.zh: 我钳子夹你手指，夹不住。
lines.en: I pinch your finger and cannot hold on.

lines.zh: 离了沙，我浑身不自在。
lines.en: Away from sand, everything feels wrong.

lines.zh: 你要带我去哪，海在那边。
lines.en: Where are you taking me? The sea is the other way.

lines.zh: 我壳上还沾着湿沙，别抖我。
lines.en: Wet sand clings to my shell; do not shake me.

lines.zh: 放我下去，我自己会走。
lines.en: Put me down; I can walk on my own.

lines.zh: 你手心的温度比我高多了。
lines.en: Your palm is much warmer than I am.

lines.zh: 我眼柄缩进去了，怕高。
lines.en: My stalks have pulled in; I fear heights.

lines.zh: 幽灵蟹钳不是这么取的。
lines.en: That is not how you harvest a ghost claw.

lines.zh: 我横着挣，挣不开你的手。
lines.en: I struggle sideways and cannot leave your hand.

lines.zh: 那只海龟又爬过来了。
lines.en: That turtle is crawling over again.

lines.zh: 我看见它的鳍在沙上拖。
lines.en: I see its flippers dragging on the sand.

lines.zh: 钻进沙里，等你走近。
lines.en: I'll sink into the sand and wait.

lines.zh: 挡在我洞口的，都得挨一下。
lines.en: Anything at my burrow mouth gets pinched.

lines.zh: 我把钳子张开，等它靠近。
lines.en: I open my claws and wait for it to come.

lines.zh: 沙里那道影子就是目标。
lines.en: That shadow on the sand is my target.

lines.zh: 我横着慢慢挪，别惊动它。
lines.en: I edge sideways slowly so I do not startle it.

lines.zh: 它爬得慢，我正好赶上。
lines.en: It crawls slowly, so I can catch up.

lines.zh: 我锁定了它的后鳍。
lines.en: I have fixed on its hind flipper.

lines.zh: 这一片沙滩归我管。
lines.en: This stretch of beach is mine to guard.

lines.zh: 我压低头，钳子往前伸。
lines.en: I lower my shell and push my claws forward.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就跟着挪。
lines.en: When it moves, I shift with it.

lines.zh: 我在等它把鳍放下来。
lines.en: I wait for it to lower that flipper.

lines.zh: 我的眼柄一直对着它。
lines.en: My eye stalks stay pointed at it.

lines.zh: 我举着钳子，横着走。
lines.en: I raise my claws and scuttle sideways.

lines.zh: 它没看见我，沙色帮了我。
lines.en: It has not seen me; my sand color helps.

lines.zh: 我钳子张到最大，别出声。
lines.en: My claws are wide open; keep quiet.

lines.zh: 我算着它下一次落脚。
lines.en: I count where its next step will land.

lines.zh: 它转头了，我先不动。
lines.en: It turned its head, so I hold still.

lines.zh: 从沙里钻出来，我盯住你。
lines.en: I burst out of the sand and fix on you.

lines.zh: 我钳住它的鳍，死不松。
lines.en: I clamp its flipper and will not let go.

lines.zh: 一下不够，我再夹第二下。
lines.en: One pinch is not enough; I clamp again.

lines.zh: 它甩我，我被甩进沙里。
lines.en: It flings me off and I land in the sand.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的脚，沙都扬起来。
lines.en: I bite its foot and sand flies up.

lines.zh: 我小，可我下手快。
lines.en: I am small, but I strike fast.

lines.zh: 它缩壳了，我夹不动。
lines.en: It pulled in; I cannot pinch through that.

lines.zh: 我钳尖划过它的皮，红了。
lines.en: My claw tip grazes its hide and it reddens.

lines.zh: 打不过我就钻沙，改天再来。
lines.en: If I lose, I dive into sand and come back later.

lines.zh: 它退了两步，我追了一步。
lines.en: It backs two steps; I follow one.

lines.zh: 这一夹是替我的洞报仇。
lines.en: This pinch is for my ruined burrow.

lines.zh: 我从沙里钻出来，身上全是沙。
lines.en: I come up out of the sand covered in it.

lines.zh: 潮刚退，我就生在这片湿沙上。
lines.en: The tide just left; I was born on this wet sand.

lines.zh: 我旁边还有一只，一起钻出来。
lines.en: Another rises beside me from the sand.

lines.zh: 沙子里钻惯了，光太刺眼。
lines.en: I burrow in sand; this light stings.

lines.zh: 我钳子还软，先找洞躲着。
lines.en: My claws are still soft, so I look for a burrow.

lines.zh: 沙子从我壳上滑下去。
lines.en: Sand slides off my new shell.

lines.zh: 我闻到了海，也闻到了海龟。
lines.en: I smell the sea, and I smell turtles too.

lines.zh: 我横着走了几步，站稳了。
lines.en: I take a few sideways steps and steady myself.

lines.zh: 这片沙滩上已经有别的蟹了。
lines.en: Other crabs are already on this beach.

lines.zh: 我举钳子对着太阳，试试力气。
lines.en: I raise my claws at the sun to test them.

lines.zh: 火烧得我壳发白，像被烤过。
lines.en: Fire bleaches my shell as if baked.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下，壳磕在石上。
lines.en: I fall from high and my shell hits stone.

lines.zh: 我在水里扑腾，腿划不到底。
lines.en: I thrash in the water and find no bottom.

lines.zh: 炸风把我掀出老远，沙都焦了。
lines.en: The blast throws me far and scorches the sand.

lines.zh: 一支箭插在我壳缝里，晃着。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shell seam, wobbling.

lines.zh: 那股怪味钻进壳里，我发冷。
lines.en: That strange chill seeps through my shell.

lines.zh: 我饿得去啃自己掉的钳子。
lines.en: Hungry, I gnaw my own shed claw.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我整只蟹都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning falls and numbs my whole body.

lines.zh: 沙滩不见了，我往下沉。
lines.en: The beach is gone and I keep sinking.
